_comment: Throwaway config for check_model_load.py only -- NOT an evaluation config. Verifies a candidate base model loads and generates before ~8h of training is queued against it. Run with: OCPQ_MODEL_IDX="0" OCPQ_MODEL_CHECK_CONFIG=eval_config.candidate.json sbatch submit_model_check.sh   ... index 0 only: with no fine_tune_map entry, expand_models synthesises a '<name>-finetuned' model that does not exist yet.
